title: LLMSafeGuard: A Framework for Safeguarding the Text Generation of Large Language Model in Real-time
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on detoxification (reducing toxic output) and copyright safeguarding.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
